017

019    private GlucoseValueStatus glucoseValueStatus;
020    private int cgmDataTypeRaw;

033    public DexcomG7CGMHistoryLog() {}
034    public DexcomG7CGMHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, int egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval, int egvCount) {
035        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
036        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmask, interval, egvCount);
037        parse(cargo);
038        
039    }

041    /**
042     * Builds a record with {@code egvCount} = 0, as in the Mobi G7 fixtures.
043     */
044    public DexcomG7CGMHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, int egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
045        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmask, interval, 0);
046    }
047
048    public DexcomG7CGMHistoryLog(int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, int egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
049        this(0, 0, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmask, interval);
050    }
051
052    public int typeId() {
053        return 399;
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * <table border="1">
058     * <caption>Parsed fields for DexcomG7CGMHistoryLog:</caption>
059     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatusRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatus</code></td><td><code>getGlucoseValueStatus()</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataType</code></td><td><code>getCgmDataType()</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>rate</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>algorithmStateRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>algorithmState</code></td><td><code>getAlgorithmState()</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>rssi</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>currentGlucoseDisplayValue</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>egvTimestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>egvInfoBitmaskRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>egvInfo</code></td><td><code>getEgvInfo()</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>interval</code></td><td><code>raw[24]</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>egvCount</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
073     * </table>
074     */
075    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
076        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
077        this.cargo = raw;
078        parseBase(raw);
079        this.glucoseValueStatusRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
080        this.glucoseValueStatus = getGlucoseValueStatus();
081        this.cgmDataTypeRaw = raw[12];
082        this.cgmDataType = getCgmDataType();
083        this.rate = raw[13];
084        this.algorithmStateRaw = raw[14];
085        this.algorithmState = getAlgorithmState();
086        this.rssi = raw[15];
087        this.currentGlucoseDisplayValue = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
088        this.egvTimestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
089        this.egvInfoBitmaskRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
090        this.egvInfo = getEgvInfo();
091        this.interval = raw[24];
092        this.egvCount = raw[25] & 0xFF;
093        
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * Builds a record with {@code egvCount} = 0, as in the Mobi G7 fixtures.
098     */
099    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, int egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
100        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmStateRaw, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, egvTimestamp, egvInfoBitmask, interval, 0);
101    }
102
103    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmStateRaw, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, int egvTimestamp, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval, int egvCount) {
104        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
105            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(399, 1), // nibble is capture-dependent (see getHeaderHighNibble javadoc); 1 preserved here since all known 399 fixtures carry it
106            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
107            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
108            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatusRaw), 
109            new byte[]{ (byte) cgmDataTypeRaw }, 
110            new byte[]{ (byte) rate }, 
111            new byte[]{ (byte) algorithmStateRaw }, 
112            new byte[]{ (byte) rssi }, 
113            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue), 
114            Bytes.toUint32(egvTimestamp), 
115            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask), 
116            new byte[]{ (byte) interval },
117            new byte[]{ (byte) egvCount }));
118    }
119    public int getGlucoseValueStatusRaw() {

121    }

124    }

127    }

139    public enum AlgorithmState {
140        WARMUP(2),
141        DEFAULT_ELECTRONICS_WAKEUP(30),
142        DETECTING_DEPLOYMENT(31),
143        REPORTABLE_PERIOD_VALID_EGV(32),
144        REPORTABLE_PERIOD_INVALID_EGV(33),
145        STOPPED_END_OF_SESSION(34),
146        STOPPED_ALG_DETECTED_FAILURE(35),
147        STOPPED_MANUAL_STOP(36),
148        STOPPED_TX_FAILURE(37),
149        STOPPED_SIV_FAILURE(38),
150        STOPPED_ENNVIRONMENTAL_CONDITIONS(39)
151
152        ;
153        private int id;
154        AlgorithmState(int id) {
155            this.id = id;
156        }
157
158        public static AlgorithmState fromId(int id) {
159            for (AlgorithmState r : values()) {
160                if (r.id == id) {
161                    return r;
162                }
163            }
164            return null;
165        }
166
167        public int getId() {
168            return id;
169        }
170    }
171
172    public AlgorithmState getAlgorithmState() {

174    }
